headline: The Desk proved Roast and Signature Bit with real source-bound stories, then staged the content-pure overlay.

items.title: Roast and Signature Bit shipped
items.insight: The Desk's light formats are now public artifacts, not table entries. Both stories use primary-source facts, no fake prediction block, and the standard News pipeline.

items.title: News visual proof mechanized
items.insight: The local image viewer was unavailable, so S312 records machine-checked rendered pixels instead of claiming an eyeball pass.

items.title: Staging content overlay deployed
items.insight: Canonical staging now carries the content-pure overlay while identity, Worker code, and full-site promotion remain held.

followUps: Commit and push S312 to main.
Live-probe both new story URLs and the News feed after deployment.
blockers: Full-site production promotion remains held by Obelisk real-provider evidence; use only the identity-isolated content lane for this News release.
